## Technical analysis (Monday July 6, 2026 — KRX July 6 closed; morning brief 11:15 UTC)

The July 6 close of ₩2,343,000 with -3.38% (-₩82,000) mathematically confirms that the July 3 previous close was ₩2,425,000 — the lower figure from the conflicting web data was correct. This means:
- July 3 close: ₩2,425,000 (below ₩2,540,000 stop → Stop Day 1 triggered July 3)
- July 4-5: KRX closed (non-sessions; Stop Day 2 determination delayed)
- July 6 close: ₩2,343,000 (below ₩2,540,000 → Stop Day 2 confirmed)
- July 7 KST open: MANDATORY FULL EXIT

**ADR listing context:** The July 10 SKHY ADR listing (T-3 KRX sessions) does NOT override the stop protocol. The stop is designed to preserve capital regardless of upcoming events. The ADR listing is a potential re-entry opportunity — not a reason to hold through a confirmed stop sequence.

A clean SKHY entry at offering price on July 10 may be more attractive than holding the legacy KRX stop-sequence position.
